ui.teamBridge.scope: All 113 ru ui.teamBridge values vs the 113-key en snapshot sha256 0dfc0c5e… and context 267fc189… (ICU/placeholder/CLDR-plural/NFC/bidi checked in bytes, terminology vs other ru ui.*.json); NOT valid for en 92f6c40f… (109 keys), which replaced the source during the audit.

findings.proposed: У этого участника Team Bridge ещё не включён
findings.note: The English names the person as the one who has not turned it on (context: it states the person’s choice), but the impersonal Russian drops the person and, as a tooltip, can read as the reader’s own Team Bridge being off; naming the participant keeps it gender-free and unambiguous.

findings.current: Вы вышли из учётной записи. Войдите, чтобы пользоваться Team Bridge.
findings.proposed: Вы не вошли в учётную запись. Войдите, чтобы пользоваться Team Bridge.
findings.note: «Вы вышли» asserts a sign-out action that may never have happened (fresh install), while the English states only the state; «не вошли» is accurate in both cases.

findings.proposed: Предпросмотр (keep; confirm in a rendered rail frame)
findings.note: 12 characters against 7 in a shrink-0 badge in a 30px rail row, so it squeezes the channel name; the term matches the product’s established «Предпросмотр», so verify truncation in a render before considering a shorter word such as «Просмотр».
